mutex_lowering.note: qcore_frontend::source_mutex::lower_source_mutex, reached through compile_files. Both `mutex rank N guards R` declarations and both nested `with lock` sections lower; the ranked spelling is what admits the nesting at all, and `declares_lock_rank` decides that once over the whole source before any statement is lowered.

mutex_invariant_check.note: qcore_core::mutex_invariant::check_mutex_invariant_program. Refusal at Q624 LockRankViolation on the descending acquisition, with the exact ordered cascade [Q624, Q612 DeadGuard]. The trailing entry is pinned rather than filtered: the refused Lock mints no guard, so the inner section's own unlock names a dead one, and a change that started silently releasing or minting a guard would move the vector.

aux:accepted_control.note: The case with one statement changed: the second section nests `b` inside `a` again instead of the reverse. It checks and the harness asserts it took the checked mutex-guard route, so Q624 is attributable to the descending edge rather than to nesting, to the two sections, or to the module declaring ranks. Route-checked; no emission or native run is claimed. Measured on Linux; on a host outside the gate the runner reports the Q500 refusal instead of skipping silently.

aux:unranked_control.note: The case's own shape with both declarations unranked. Both nestings refuse at Q622 UnsupportedSynchronizationConstruct { NestedProtectingMutex }, one per nesting — the represented refusal that stood before card CT33-RANKS. This is what makes `nesting is admitted only where a rank is declared` a measured statement rather than a claim in prose, and it runs on every host.

CT34.why_still_unmapped: CreateMutex still fixes its declared footprints at creation and consumes the creator's FULL_ACCESS share over each of them; there is no growth form, and post-creation protection growth is a represented refusal rather than something a program can write down. A lock rank orders acquisitions of existing generations and changes nothing about what a mutex protects, so CT33-RANKS did not create a protection-growth form and the wave-5 reason stands verbatim in substance.
